RESULT [continual]: +13.12% RAI on the Pascal Series (4 tasks) with an 89.3% Average Retention Index, and +11.39% RAI on the Diverse Weather Series (3 tasks) with an 88.57% Average Retention Index.
US [continual]: This is the only paper found that shows task-arithmetic merging working on YOLO11 and RT-DETR detectors, the two families the trainer uses (YOLO and RF-DETR are close relatives). It covers our setting, where harvested increments change both domain (farm, camera) and sometimes class (new species). It is a useful existence proof before trying WiSE-FT or MagMax on YOLO.
